turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr./Ms. [Name]. I'm [Provider's Name], the anesthesiologist who'll be taking care of you during your surgery today. I'd like to go over a few things to make sure everything goes smoothly for your laparoscopic appendectomy under general anesthesia with an LMA.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doctor. I'm ready, just a bit nervous lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's completely normal. Let's start with your current health. Can you tell me a bit about your symptoms and how long you've been having them?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure. I've had tummy pain for about two days, mostly on the right side. It's been getting worse, and I've had some fever and loss of appetite. The doctor said it's appendicitis and needs to come out.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Now, let's go over your medications. I see you're on Atorvastatin, Omeprazole, and Paracetamol as needed. Can you confirm the current dose of Atorvastatin you're taking?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes. I was on 10 mg daily for a while, but my doctor increased it to 20 mg daily about three months ago because my cholesterol levels were still high.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. And how often are you taking the Omeprazole and Paracetamol?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I take Omeprazole every morning, and Paracetamol only when I have pain or fever. I actually stopped taking it a few days ago when the pain started.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Got it. And do you have any allergies we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I had a rash when I took Penicillin before, so I'm allergic to that.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. We'll make sure to avoid Penicillin and related antibiotics. Now, about your health history — you mentioned obesity and hyperlipidemia. Are you managing these well?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I try my best, but with my BMI at 28.5, it's been a struggle. I walk a bit and watch my diet, but I know I need to do more.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's good to hear. Any other medical conditions or recent illnesses?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing else. I haven't been sick recently except for this.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Have you had any anesthesia before? Any issues with it?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, this is my first time. I've never had surgery before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright. And finally, are you NPO as instructed? Nothing by mouth since midnight?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I haven't eaten or drunk anything since last night. Just a sip of water for my morning meds.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Thank you for going through all that with me. I'll be with you throughout the surgery and make sure you're comfortable and safe. Any questions before we proceed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all. Thanks, doctor.
